VAT). Dishes and catering not entered. GPU 10 × 30 min 1,650, waste 40, communication 272.02, crew transfer 65. No separate weekend charge on Saturday/Sunday (night charge on the Sunday departure, single charge). Security fee unclean arrival (GAT) 95 (arrival from outside the EU; untick 'in total' for EU arrivals) in basket. Lavatory 170 and BER fresh water + lavatory station 2.36 in basket, all groups by user decision (2.36 also for Execujet). Waste disposal 80 (safe side; 40 on the previous invoice). Communication fee AFZ 290.02 (safe side; September 221.02). Noise on this flight 109.27; panel uses the higher 152.12 for AFZ. Passenger transfer tick, highest 2,447.50 (fourth invoice); crew transfer highest 97.50 (fifth invoice; 55 and 75 on others). Dishes, dry storage, catering not entered. SECOND INVOICE 17025582 (25 Aug 2026; A6-AFC GLEX XRS 45.132 t, LFMN–EDDB–LFMN, 14.08.2026 14:50–16:24 UTC, 0 + 2 pax) and BER 4100075845: handling 40–50 t band 995; in this band 'handling discount 5.37%' was ADDED to the total (+53.47); by user decision (safe side) handling 1,048.47 and energy surcharge 5% on it (+2.67 vs invoice). EGKB.notes: Biggin Hill Airport Ltd does its own handling (FBO + airport on one invoice). Source invoices SINV022016, 026852, 027121 (T7-ELL, GL6T 46 t), SINV024888 (T7-ALEX1, GLEX 43 t), SINV024668 and 025771 (T7-AFZ, GL7T 53 t), SINV026802 (A6-AFO, E35L). Fixed fees by weight class (GBP): E35L class landing 1,115 / international levy 190 / parking 25 per hour / handling 315; GLEX–GL6T class 1,820 / 263 / 42 / 495; GL7T 2,055 / 275 / 48 / 560. Sustainability levy 3.15 per ton (20 units on the AFO invoice), NATS approach 16.40. Parking: first 2 h free, then every started hour; after the first 24 billed hours 80% of the hourly rate (42 → 33.60, 48 → 38.40). On the T7-AFZ 10–25 August invoice (354 h) only 133 h parking charged (probably hangar); panel calculates the full stay. No invoice for ALX1·KBI (CL60) and FLH (GLF4), no prices entered. Toilet 130, belt loader 165. Waste disposal 52.50 per bag, dishes 50, ice 12, catering, laundry, crew/passenger transport not in comparison. No disbursement; VAT 20% only on transfers. Price list (George Day e-mail, 24 Aug 2026, Ground Services): water 130, GPU 165 per hour, air start 725 and tug & driver 165 (pushback) in basket; airstairs 100, security escort 95, excess baggage 150 and de-icing callout 300 (+ 7.50 per litre) tick. PLS & Security Charge (flights under NASP, on top of handling) 225 up to 6 pax, 60 per pax from the 7th: tick under Airport fees (on no invoice). No extra charge for technical stops; VIP service free, passenger services included in handling. They do not assist with landing permits. Invoice BQH-253025 (N194MF G550 41.2 t, BAND K, EGGW–EGKB–OMAD, 15–19 Apr 2026): same as ALEX group prices; international levy not charged for a domestic arrival (untick 'in total' for domestic arrivals). Foil trays, cancelled transfer and booking fee not entered. JETEX (Jetex London Biggin Hill, FBO): Offer 5 from Jetex e-mail 4 Nov 2026 (comparison file "JETEXs vs Biggin Hill EGKB Comparisons – Revised – V4 Final"; GBP). Handling (published 515/570/625/695 → Offer 5) SNR1·ALX1·KBI·OWN·BVY·AFO 386, ALEX·FLH 428, ELL group 469, AFZ 521; landing 1,365 / 1,750 / 1,820 / 2,055; border levy 220 / 250 / 263 / 275; parking per day 487.50 / 663 / 897 / 838.50 (first 2 h free); sustainability levy 3.50 per ton; London approach (NERL) 17.40; security screening 650 per service or 75 per person, whichever is greater; ASU 700, GPU 155, tug & driver 200, toilet 130, water 180, waste 65 per bag, airside escort 125, airstairs 250, belt loader 200; disbursement 10% on all third-party charges (airport fees). The same file shows Biggin Hill prices: SNR1 group handling 315, landing 1,365, levy 220, parking 550 per day (25 per hour × 22 h); ALEX·FLH 495 / 1,750 / 250 / 924. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): JETEX added (FBO), all groups; Jetex landing and border levy as in Excel; Biggin Hill keeps invoice-based values (E35L 1,115 / 190, GL5T 1,820 / 263); missing Biggin Hill groups CL60 and GLF4 filled from the comparison file (CL60 315 / 1,365 / 220 / 25 per hour; GLF4 495 / 1,750 / 250 / 42 per hour; sustainability 3.15 per ton; other services as other groups); Jetex parking first 2 h free then per started 24 h; security screening as tick row like Biggin Hill. Biggin Hill disbursement 15% (comparison file) applies to third-party charges only (catering, transfers etc., not in panel); not applied to Biggin Hill's own airport fees, consistent with invoices (user decision 13 Nov 2026). USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): Excess Baggage row deleted; Category 1 Waste Disposal renamed Waste Disposal and moved to the basket (with qty, per bag); Security Escort moved to the basket. Waste Disposal row renamed Trash / Waste Removal (panel standard, 13 Nov 2026).

Source: Sky Service invoices 2660 (A6-AFC, 19 Jun 2026), 2861 (N194MF, 29–30 Jun), 3113 and 3136 (A6-FLH, 13–17 Jul), 3377 (T7-ALEX1, 28–31 Jul), 3526 (T7-ELL, 10–11 Aug) with SEA Prime attachments; Sky Service handling table (by MTOW day/night, standard and 10% discounted) and compulsory services table; SEA Prime tariff (March 2026). Invoices at standard price, so standard price in panel (user decision). Handling at day price; difference to night price in Surcharge Night row, once per flight if arrival or departure 18:00–08:00 (night hours derived from invoices, user approved). Group MTOWs: AFZ 53 t (user-approved assumption, not in table; per ton), ELL group 46, ALEX group 42, FLH 34 (not in table; per ton, night 673.30 on invoice), OWN group 23, ALX1·KBI 22. Compulsory: apron coordination 7 per ton, GAT 25, pushback 17–39 t 150 / 40–70 t 190. Lav and water 16–30 t 85, 31–70 t 120; GPU 130 per 30 min, 260 for 1 h in panel; ASU 600 per hour. Customs & government non-Schengen 50 per movement (remove from total for Schengen flights). Garbage 20. Commission only on SEA Prime airport fees (excl. VAT). AIRPORT (SEA Prime): landing/take-off per ton first 25 t 18.94, 26–50 t 18.46, over 50 t 18.27, landing and take-off separately; doubled for private (general aviation) flights (Increase row; remove from total for TAXI flights, e.g. A6-AFC and A6-FLH). Follow-me 49.80. Parking first 2 h free, then every started hour 0.44 per ton / after 24th hour 0.61 / after 72nd hour 0.84. Pax fees 28.67 per departing pax (non-Schengen 16.46 + security 4.05 + PRM 1.16 + additional pax fees 7.00; 25.09 for Schengen). Stamp 2 + 2. Tick: dedicated supervisor 45, ramp staff 30, remote stand follow-me 85 and pushback, conveyor belt long 300, porter 50, catering delivery 45, catering security 21.50, storage 50, print 15. Catering, limousine and taxi not entered (variable). SIGNATURE (Signature Flight Support Italy, EUR): source invoices LIN-C-I-02-2600138 (T7-ELL, 13–16 Jan 2026, Low Season Standard, LFPB–LIML–LFPB) and LIN-C-I-02-2505075 (T7-AFZ, 25–28 Dec 2025, LFPB–LIML–HECA) with SEA Prime attachments. Prices only for ELL group (handling 1,058) and AFZ (1,114); other groups empty (user decision). Handling at invoice price (Low Season Standard); Signature draft tariff (H band 919, G 661, F 474) below invoices, not used; non-invoiced groups empty (user decision). Sunday 30% (handling), out of hours 20:00–08:00 30% once per flight (draft tariff's 00:00–04:59 50% band not applied, user decision). Public holiday handling 50% (T7-AFZ 25 Dec: 557); holiday list Italian public holidays + 24–26 Dec and 31 Dec. Airport fees same as SEA Prime (Sky rows); AFZ parking only for Signature 1.307 times per T7-AFZ invoice (Sky Service side unchanged, user decision), plus 20% administrative services (disbursement). Pax fee 29.33 per departing pax on the safe side (2025 non-Schengen: security 3.81, PRM 1.02, additional fees 7.00, non-Schengen 17.50). Lav 190 (with qty), water 190, pushback 230, GPU 230 unit price taken as 30 min on the safe side (1 h 460; GPU duration not on supporting documents), waste 35 (garbage row), communication 25. Apron coordination, GAT, ASU and customs not on Signature invoices (empty). Tick: belt loader 140 (conveyor belt row, with qty), print 12, transport booking 25, catering coordination 25, wet ice 15 (with qty), tax free procedure 150. Fuel call-out 30 not entered (user decision). Limousine, taxi, catering not entered. Basic handling 45 per ton; night 20:00–08:00 +50% and weekend (Sat–Sun) / Italian public holidays +50% on handling, once per flight; office hours 08:00–20:00, overtime 150 per hour in Surcharge section (automatic, started hours). GA terminal 10 per ton in GAT Service row (Delta's own fee, no disbursement); ramp safety & security checks 85, dedicated supervisor arrival & departure 300 (single amount per flight), communications 100, all in basket. 15% on 3rd party = disbursement 15% on airport fees. LIRA.notes:
SKY SERVICE (Rome Ciampino), EUR, excl. VAT (22% VAT on commission only). Sources: invoices 1263 and 1267 (A6-AFA, 17 and 19 May 2026), 1597 and 1676 (A6-AFA, 13–15 Jun), 1754 and 1953 (A6-AFC, 4 and 20 Jul; 1953 state flight), 1849 (T7-ALEX1 42 t, 11 Jul), 1945 (A6-FLH 34 t, 21 Jul, LIMJ → LIEO domestic), Sky Service LIRA handling table + compulsory services; preventivo 885 (A6-AFD, 2 Nov 2026); preventivo 909 (7 Nov 2026) and invoice 3037 (8 Nov 2026; A6-AFD GLEX 45 t TAXI, 2 pax, 6 Nov 10:00 – 8 Nov 11:00 LT, 47 h).
Standard handling (day rate) = 50 + 11.70 × t: ALX1·KBI 22 t 307.40, OWN 23 t 319.10, FLH 34 t 447.80, ALEX group (safe side, 45 t) 576.50, ELL 576.50 (invoice 3037, 45 t), AFZ 53 t 670.10 (formula). Night: +1.74 × t per night movement (Surcharge; ELL 80.04); night window 22:00–07:00.
Compulsory: airside coordination 90, GAT 3 per ton once per flight, PPR 100, communication 40, invoice processing 40 (invoice 3037). Pushback 11–25 t 75 / 26–50 t 190 (GLF4, GL5T, GLEX; AFZ 140). Lavatory 16–30 t 85 / 31–70 t 140; water 120 (in basket). GPU 130 per 30 min (1 h 260), ASU 340 per hour. Garbage 25, marshalling 25, dedicated supervisor 45 (basket, qty box).
Customs & government: arrival 50; departure min. 50, 10 per pax above 5 (GLEX: departure 0, invoice 3037 charged 50 once per flight).
Airport fees (TAXI): landing and departure each 23.86 per ton (GLEX 1,073.70 per invoice 3037); ALX1·KBI 24.48 (safe side); OWN group 954.40 per movement. Parking 0.10 per ton per started hour from the first hour (GLEX 4.50). Per departing pax: pax fees 85.76, security HBS 25.75, security 26.31, additional pax fees 7.50. Noise 0.90 × t (GLEX 36 per invoice 3037; AFZ 47.70). Airport stamp duty 2. Commission 3.5% on airport fees incl. stamp duty.
Tick extras: dedicated ramp staff 30, dedicated agent over 31 t 250, fuel coordination 35, crew taxi 55, limousine V class 400.95 per trip (ticked by default), card payment fee 3%. Catering not entered. State flight (1953): airport fees discounted lump 1,041.96; panel higher with TAXI tariff.
SIGNATURE (Signature Flight Support, Rome Ciampino, EUR): invoices CIA-C-I-01-2600224 (A6-FLH, 23–24 Feb 2026) and P4-OWN (28–29 Jan 2026); CIA draft tariff (F 543, G 883, H 1,019; invoices 32% higher). Prices only for FLH (handling 1,168) and OWN group (718). Airport fees as ADR tariff + 20% administrative services (disbursement); OWN landing/departure 954.40 per movement, noise 18. Slot booking 75 (PPR row), communication 26, lav and water 145, pushback 160, GPU 228 per 30 min (1 h 456). Surcharges (draft tariff): Sunday and public holidays handling 30%, out of hours 20:00–08:00 handling 30% once per flight, staff call-out 180 per movement 23:00–07:00. Holidays: Italian public holidays + 29 June (Rome). Tick: limousine one way 180 (ticked by default), transport booking 22, tax free 72, disinsection 485.
USER DECISIONS: Sky night window 22:00–07:00; parking charged from the first hour (both handlers); card payment fee 3% as tick row; (10 Nov 2026) PPR 100, communication 40, airside 90 for all groups; pushback 190 and lavatory 140 by weight band; invoice processing 40 in basket; GLEX updated to invoice 3037 (landing/departure, standard handling, noise, parking, customs once); GAT 3 per ton once per flight for all groups (latest document); water stays in basket. AVIAVIP (Argos VIP Private Handling SRL, Rome) invoice 526110193 (12 Nov 2026; T7-ELL GLEX 44,452 kg, LFPB–LIRA–OMDW, 7 Nov 2026 Saturday 12:18z / 17:18z, 3 + 3 pax, private; EUR): tax free assistance 250, handling 1,181, weekend surcharge 50% 590.50, service terminal charge 110, coordination 75, dedicated agent 150, pax assistance 85, push back 350, GPU 28V 285, permit 100, tarmac 6 × 7, porterage 6 × 12, pax transportation 1,045 (+22% VAT), catering 775, catering security 100, catering delivery 130 (catering not entered), VIP lounge 3 × 50, duty stamp 2, documentation 20, credit administration fee 75, environmental fee 60; airport fees 4,788.76: parking 13.50, HBS 3 × 25.75, IRESA 2 × 22.50 − 10%, pax charges 3 × 85.76, Roma Capitale 3 × 1.00, additional pax 3 × 6.50, landing 2 × 1,073.70, take-off 2 × 1,073.70 (private flight: double), duty stamp 2 × 2, security 3 × 26.31; disbursement / administration fees 18% on airport fees (except parking), pax transportation and catering; total 11,894.75 incl. VAT 229.90. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): AVIAVIP added (GLEX group only); private-flight GA increase row (landing + departure once more; all handlers; default unticked like LIML); disbursement 18% as on invoice (airport fees except parking, pax transport); weekend 50% Saturday + Sunday; IRESA as invoiced with 10% discount (40.50); airport stamp duty 4 and Roma Capitale 1 per departing pax for all handlers; parking hourly and additional pax 7.50 kept. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): Invoice Processing (Sky) and Credit Administration Fee (AviaVIP) merged into one tick row at the bottom; Garbage renamed Trash / Waste Removal (panel standard).

Source: invoices 1.279 (T7-AFP GLF5 42 t, OMDW–LIRF–LFPB, 12.06.2026 00:57–03:09 local, 0 pax, parking 1 h), 1.280 (T7-AFP, LTBA–LIRF–OMDW, 14.06 11:24–13:09, 9 departing pax), 1.283 (P4-BVY E135 25 t, LFPB–LIRF–LFPB, 12.06 00:04–01:27, parking 1 h), 1.284 (P4-BVY, LTBA–LIRF–LGAV, 14.06 01:59–03:40, 3 departing pax); all 11 Jul 2026. Standard handling G5 1,250, E135 1,050 (other groups not invoiced, 'not provided'). Landing and departure separately: G5 day 443.82 / night 488.12, E135 294.60 / 324.16 (night +10%, per movement; 00:04 arrival on 1283 counted as day — window unclear, safe side 22:00–07:00). By user decision other groups per ton (ALX1·KBI, FLH 11.784/t; ELL, AFZ 10.567/t). Noise emission G5 33.60, E135 20 (FLH and above 33.60). Parking per ton per hour 0.17, every started hour (G5 7.14, E135 4.25). Per departing pax (extra-EU, safe side): pax fee 25.15 (17.70 to Schengen), additional 8 (7.50), PRM 1.25 (1.21), security bag 2.19, security 3.22. Administrative fee (contract 5.3.1): airport fees 300–1,000 € 3%, over 1,000 € 3.5% → panel 3.5% percentage row (on airport items). DISBURSEMENT FEE on all four invoices exactly = (airport fees + standard handling + terminal + meet & greet + shuttle + push back) × 10% (1283: 1,928 → 193; 1284: 2,049 → 205; 1279: 2,587 → 259; 1280: 2,849 → 285); porter, invoice processing, supplier stamp, stamp duty, limousine excluded → panel disbursement 10% 'all', noDisb on these items. Terminal charge 30, meet & greet 30, shuttle per trip 45 (G5 2, E135 1; default qty by group), push back E135 130 / G5 170, invoice processing 30, supplier stamp 4, stamp duty 2 in basket. Tick: porter per piece 12.50, limousine van 520 (456.30 / 520). 22% VAT on limousine and administrative fee — not entered (excl. VAT rule). 2 Nov 2026: night difference (Surcharge) added to administrative fee base (night landing/departure amount enters the base on invoice).
LIRF.verified: SKY SERVICES invoices 1.279, 1.280 (T7-AFP) and 1.283, 1.284 (P4-BVY), Jun 2026, on the safe side: panel +16.10, +16.53, +41.16, +40.19 (excl. limousine and 22% VAT; porter qty as invoiced). Disbursement rule (airport + handling + terminal + meet & greet + shuttle + push back × 10%) exact on all four invoices. Reasons for difference: night window 22–07 (00:04 arrival on 1283 counted as day on invoice), departing pax fees at extra-EU amount (1284 Schengen), administrative fee always 3.5% incl. night difference (3% for 300–1,000 €). UGSB.notes: TBS HANDLING (Batumi), USD, excl. VAT. Source: invoices T7-KBI (15.06.26), P4-BVY (06–09.12.25), A6-AFO (24–27.06.26), T7-ELL (27–28.06.26) and A6-FLH proforma (25.10.26). Prices only for invoiced groups (ALX1·KBI, OWN·BVY·AFO, FLH, ELL group); ALEX group and AFZ empty. Handling = ramp + passenger handling (ALX1·KBI 382 + 135 = 517; other groups 732 + 285 = 1,017). Landing–take off on the safe side 7.72 per ton (7.54–7.72 on invoices; OWN group 24.3 t). Terminal charge on the safe side: ALX1·KBI 337, OWN group 365, FLH and ELL group 553. Aircraft & pax security per pax 18.34 (arrival + departure; highest per-pax value T7-KBI 55 / 3). Supervision 22–24 t 270, 34–46 t 350. Permission 30. Parking first 1 h free, every started 24 h 150. Airport passengers service fee per departing pax 12 (2026 documents; 100 on P4-BVY December 2025 invoice, taken as old tariff). CIP lounge per pax 168 (latest proforma A6-FLH 1,512 / 9), arriving and departing pax, in total (user decision: include VIP/CIP; latest proforma price as basis). CIP charged 235.40 per pax on P4-BVY December 2025 invoice; panel 651.32 lower on that invoice, old tariff/exception (user decision). Surcharges: Sunday handling 25% (not applied on Saturday); night 22:00–06:00 (assumption) handling 25% once per flight, plus landing 20% (18:00–08:00 from 11 Nov 2026, airport tariff) and security 15% per night movement (Surcharge rows). Disbursement 2% whole invoice (rounded to integer on invoices; bank procedures 100 on proforma). Tick: crew transfer 80, apron crew transport 78. Catering, dishwashing, laundry, catering storage and delivery not taken. Bank procedures 100 (instead of disbursement on A6-FLH proforma) in non-comparison items, tick (user decision). VIP AVIATION (Georgia): estimate UGSB GLEX 46 t night (Excel; 6 departing pax): navigation (terminal, landing + take-off) 519, landing 345, landing night 20% 69, ramp handling 732 + 25% 183, passenger handling 285 + 25% 71.25, parking 150, pax service 72, pax security 33, load control 25, aircraft security 115 + night 15% 17.25 (third party 2,616.50; crew transfer on apron 78 listed but not in the total); VIP Aviation representation 290, communication 50; total 2,956.50. All groups filled from the VIP Aviation charges table and the Batumi Intl standard price list by MTOW (user decision): handling = ramp + pax (8–22 t 385 + 135, 23–50 t 732 + 285, 51–104 t 1,045 + 545); landing 7.50/t (international, over 14 t); aircraft security 2.50/t; pax service 12 and pax security 5.50 per departing pax; load control 25 (standard); terminal navigation scaled from the estimate by (MTOW/46)^0.7 (Batumi unit rate not stated); representation (handling arrangements) 290 for 8–70 t; communication 50; ordinary permit free, urgent (< 5 h) 50 tick. Surcharges: ramp + pax handling 25% at night 22:00–06:00 or weekend (Saturday 13:00 – Monday 06:00; Saturday and Sunday entered on the safe side), once; landing 20% per night movement 20:00–06:00 summer / 18:00–08:00 winter (18:00–08:00 entered for both handlers on the safe side, user decision; previously 22–06 assumption); aircraft security 15% per night movement 22:00–06:00. Parking charter: first 3 h free; over 15 min rounded to an hour, one extra hour to a full 24 h; up to 50 t 150 summer / 75 winter, 51–100 t 300 / 150 (summer rate entered). CIP lounge 115 EUR arrival / 140 EUR departure per pax (129 / 158 USD at 1.1215). Equipment (Batumi list): GPU 55 / 30 min, ACU 127 / 30 min, ASU 248 (up to 153 t), pushback 110, potable water 99, lavatory 99 (basket); tick: tow bar 50, fire brigade 55, VIP bus 33, pax bus 39, meet & assist 23, conveyor 94/h, pax steps 94/h, wheelchair 30, baggage identification 80, de-icing truck 425, crew transport on apron 78, crew transport to/from hotel 60 per way (up to 4 persons). Catering items and catering arrangement not entered. VIP Aviation credit 8% on all third-party charges (except fuel) entered as disbursement on the safe side (user decision; not on the estimate); not applied to representation and communication.
UGSB.verified: TBS Handling: invoices T7-KBI (+151.52), A6-AFO night (+129.83), T7-ELL Sunday (+598.79) and A6-FLH proforma (+37.24) on the safe side (excl. catering, dishwashing, laundry, storage; incl. CIP). P4-BVY December 2025 invoice −651.32 due to old CIP tariff (235.40 per pax), exception (user decision).
